tags.gist: Wants the two escalation errors treated unequally, letting Class II triage devices favor high sensitivity to avoid missing serious conditions.
Would accept more over-escalation when an intermediate pathway such as a telehealth nurse exists, with the balance justified by intended use and population.
Suggests FDA establish a standardized out-of-domain test dataset to check whether devices recognize situations beyond their validated scope.
Suggests a predefined deferral threshold, for example 95 percent appropriate deferral on out-of-scope scenarios, adjusted to intended use and risk.
Wants over-deferral evaluated too, since needless referral of in-scope questions would reduce clinical utility.
